::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 10th [1891-1893]  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

My dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd)
Articles addressed to the Ed of [M P](organizations/other_52.qmd) go to [Miss Coleridge](people/person_329.qmd).[^1] She has been from home and things go to arrears, which she has hardly made up yet, but I will tell her to see about your paper.

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Joint editorship of the *MP* began in July 1891. CMY retired from the editorship in December 1893.
